# Introduction

Ulve are aggressive creatures found in Mountains inside Frost Caves. Their appearance is distinctly werewolf-like, however unlike Fenrings, they trot on all-fours.

### Drops

• Item: Ulv trophy | 0 Star: 10%

• Item: Wolf fang | 0 Star: 50%

### Spawning

• Type: Common spawn point in Frost Caves. | Limit: - | Frequency: One time | Stars: No

• Type: Common spawn point in Howling Caverns. | Limit: - | Frequency: One time | Stars: Yes (Only 1-Star)

### Bite

Crouches down before swinging up to bite the player (80 Slash damage). This extends 2.2 meters in a 25-degree horizontal arc and can be used every 5 seconds when within 1.5 meters of a player.

### Slash

Steps back before lifting both paws to slash downward (70 Slash damage). It has a vertical hitbox that hits 2.5 meters out and spans 60 degrees. This has a 9-second cooldown and can be used within 3 meters of a player.

## Notes

• Ulv is from Old Norse ulfr. The word is still used in both Norway and Denmark but became taboo in Sweden and replaced with varg.
